title: Comparative Adjectives (older than, more important than) - Basic Comparisons

options.answer: My brother is more taller than me.
My brother is tall than me.
My brother is taller than me.

explanation.en: For one-syllable adjectives like 'tall,' we add '-er' to form the comparative. We do not use 'more.'
explanation.ru: Для односложных прилагательных, таких как 'tall', мы добавляем '-er' для образования сравнительной степени. Мы не используем 'more.'
explanation.uz: 'Tall' kabi bir bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun taqqoslash darajasini hosil qilish uchun '-er' qo'shimchasini qo'shamiz. 'More' dan foydalanilmaydi.

options.answer: A car is faster a bicycle.
A car is faster than a bicycle.
A car is more fast than a bicycle.

explanation.en: When comparing two things, you must use 'than' after the comparative adjective.
explanation.ru: При сравнении двух вещей вы должны использовать 'than' после сравнительного прилагательного.
explanation.uz: Ikki narsani solishtirishda, taqqoslash sifatidan keyin 'than' so'zidan foydalanishingiz kerak.

options.answer: This book is more interesting as that one.
This book is more interesting that that one.
This book is more interesting than that one.

explanation.en: To compare two things with multi-syllable adjectives, use 'more' and 'than.' 'As' is used for similarity, not comparison.
explanation.ru: Чтобы сравнить два предмета с многосложными прилагательными, используйте 'more' и 'than.' 'As' используется для сходства, а не для сравнения.
explanation.uz: Bir nechta bo'g'inli sifatlar bilan ikki narsani solishtirish uchun 'more' va 'than' dan foydalaning. 'As' o'xshashlik uchun ishlatiladi, taqqoslash uchun emas.

options.answer: London is bigger than Paris.
London is big than Paris.
London is more big than Paris.

explanation.en: For one-syllable adjectives that end in a consonant and have a single vowel before it, you double the consonant before adding '-er.'
explanation.ru: Для односложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на согласную с одной гласной перед ней, согласная удваивается перед добавлением '-er.'
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri undosh harf bilan tugab, undan oldin bitta unli harf bo'lsa, '-er' qo'shimchasini qo'shishdan oldin undosh harf ikki marta yoziladi.

options.answer: The sun is warmer than the moon.
The sun is more warm than the moon.
The sun is warm than the moon.

explanation.en: The correct comparative form of the one-syllable adjective 'warm' is 'warmer.'
explanation.ru: Правильная сравнительная форма односложного прилагательного 'warm' - 'warmer.'
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli 'warm' sifatining to'g'ri taqqoslash darajasi 'warmer' bo'ladi.

options.answer: This movie is more boring than the last one.
This movie is boringer than the last one.
This movie is more boring as the last one.

explanation.en: For adjectives with two or more syllables like 'boring,' we use 'more' to form the comparative.
explanation.ru: Для прилагательных, состоящих из двух и более слогов, таких как 'boring,' мы используем 'more' для образования сравнительной степени.
explanation.uz: 'Boring' kabi ikki yoki undan ortiq bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun taqqoslash darajasini hosil qilish uchun 'more' dan foydalanamiz.

options.answer: An elephant is big than a mouse.

An elephant is bigger than a mouse.

explanation.en: The comparative form of 'big' is 'bigger.' The final consonant is doubled because it's a CVC word.
explanation.ru: Сравнительная форма 'big' - 'bigger.' Конечная согласная удваивается, потому что это слово типа 'согласная-гласная-согласная'.
explanation.uz: 'Big' sifatining taqqoslash darajasi 'bigger' bo'ladi. U oxirgi undosh harf bilan tugaganligi uchun u ikki marta yoziladi.

options.answer: My phone is newer than your phone.

My phone is more new than your phone.

explanation.en: For the one-syllable adjective 'new,' the correct comparative form is 'newer.'
explanation.ru: Для односложного прилагательного 'new' правильная сравнительная форма - 'newer.'
explanation.uz: Bir bo'g'inli 'new' sifati uchun to'g'ri taqqoslash darajasi 'newer' bo'ladi.

options.answer: She is more happy than her sister.
She is happier than her sister.
She is happy than her sister.

explanation.en: For two-syllable adjectives ending in '-y,' change the 'y' to 'i' and add '-er.'
explanation.ru: Для двусложных прилагательных, оканчивающихся на '-y', измените 'y' на 'i' и добавьте '-er.'
explanation.uz: '-y' bilan tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun 'y' harfini 'i'ga o'zgartirib, '-er' qo'shimchasini qo'shing.

options.answer: This car is more expensive as that one.

explanation.uz: 'Expensive' kabi ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar uchun taqqoslash darajasini hosil qilish uchun sifatdan oldin 'more' so'zidan foydalaning.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words

items.text: My family lives in a small town. It is much ___1___ than the city. Life here is also ___2___ than in the city. Our house is ___3___ than my grandparents' house. It has four bedrooms, and their house has only two. My sister, Clara, is two years ___4___ than me. She is also a lot ___5___ than I am because she loves to study. I think my school is ___6___ than her school, but she disagrees. My mother says that our house is ___7___ than my sister's messy room. My father's car is ___8___ than our old car, but it is not as fast as our neighbor's car. I think our dog, Max, is ___9___ than any other dog in the world. He is the ___10___ pet I have ever had.

explanation.en: The text uses comparative adjectives to describe differences between things and people. 'Quieter,' 'safer,' 'bigger,' 'older,' 'smarter,' and 'newer' are formed by adding '-er' to the base adjective. 'Friendlier' changes the 'y' to an 'i' and adds '-er'. 'Better' is an irregular form of 'good.' 'Best' is a superlative, indicating the highest degree of a quality.
explanation.ru: В тексте используются сравнительные прилагательные для описания различий между вещами и людьми. 'Quieter,' 'safer,' 'bigger,' 'older,' 'smarter' и 'newer' образуются путем добавления '-er' к базовому прилагательному. 'Friendlier' меняет 'y' на 'i' и добавляет '-er'. 'Better' - это неправильная форма 'good.' 'Best' - это превосходная степень, указывающая на высшую степень качества.
explanation.uz: Matn narsalar va odamlar o'rtasidagi farqlarni taqqoslash sifatlari yordamida tasvirlaydi. 'Quieter,' 'safer,' 'bigger,' 'older,' 'smarter' va 'newer' asosiy sifatga '-er' qo'shimchasini qo'shish orqali hosil qilinadi. 'Friendlier' so'zida 'y' 'i'ga o'zgaradi va '-er' qo'shiladi. 'Better' 'good' sifatining noto'g'ri shakli. 'Best' esa sifatning eng yuqori darajasini ko'rsatadigan sifatning ustunlik darajasidir.

His work is ___4___ and more detailed than mine. His paintings are often a lot ___5___ than mine, too. We both agree that a portrait is ___6___ to paint than a landscape because it is ___7___ to capture a person's personality. Leo's cat, Mittens, is ___8___ than my cat, Bella. Mittens loves to play, but Bella is ___9___. Leo and I have a great time painting together, but I think his art is definitely ___10___ than mine, for now.

explanation.en: The passage uses a mix of comparative forms. 'Better' is the irregular comparative form of 'good.' 'More' is used with multi-syllable adjectives like 'beautiful,' 'creative,' 'expensive,' 'difficult,' and 'active.' 'Harder' is formed by adding '-er' to 'hard.' 'Lazie'r changes the 'y' to an 'i' and adds '-er.'
explanation.ru: В тексте используется сочетание сравнительных форм. 'Better' - это неправильная сравнительная форма 'good.' 'More' используется с многосложными прилагательными, такими как 'beautiful,' 'creative,' 'expensive,' 'difficult' и 'active.' 'Harder' образуется путем добавления '-er' к 'hard.' 'Lazie'r меняет 'y' на 'i' и добавляет '-er.'
explanation.uz: Matnda taqqoslash darajasining turli xil shakllari qo'llanilgan. 'Better' 'good' sifatining noto'g'ri taqqoslash darajasi. 'More' 'beautiful,' 'creative,' 'expensive,' 'difficult' va 'active' kabi ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar bilan ishlatiladi. 'Harder' 'hard' sifatiga '-er' qo'shimchasini qo'shish orqali hosil qilinadi. 'Lazier' so'zida 'y' 'i'ga o'zgaradi va '-er' qo'shiladi.
